zh.title: 中國商飛C919高原型縮短機身款原型機於上海完成首飛
zh.summary: 中國商用飛機公司研製的C919高原型原型機於2026年7月29日在上海浦東國際機場（PVG）完成首飛，飛行時間為1小時59分。該機型編號為C919-600、註冊號B-002U，機身較標準型縮短6個框，設計載客量為140至160人，專為適應高高原機場環境營運而進行針對性改進。
body: 中國商用飛機有限責任公司（COMAC）於2026年7月29日完成其最新研製的C919高原型客機原型機的首飛測試任務。這架編號為C919-600、註冊號為B-002U的原型機當天由上海浦東國際機場（PVG）起飛，在空中進行了1小時59分鐘的試飛後順利返回並降落。
根據中國商飛隨後發布的聲明，該架C919-600原型機在首飛期間順利完成了所有預定的飛行測試科目與操縱項目。製造商表示，此次首飛的成功標誌著C919客機系列化發展與衍生機型研發工作中邁出了相當重要的階段性一步。
在進行本次首飛任務之前，該架註冊號為B-002U的原型機已於2026年6月在上海浦東國際機場完成了地面滑行測試。地面測試階段讓工程團隊能夠提前驗證飛機在地面滑行時的操縱性以及各項機載系統的基礎運作效能。
C919-600高原型客機是以C919基本型客機為基礎進行針對性改進研發。與標準版C919相比，高原型的機身結構進行了縮短處理，共計減少了約6個框的長度，同時實施了機身減重與機載系統功能優化，以滿足高海拔地區複雜氣候環境與薄空氣條件下的營運需求。
該衍生機型由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發，設計載客量設定為140至160名乘客。依據中國民用航空局的相關法規定義，凡海拔高度位於2,438公尺（相當於8,000英呎）或以上的機場，皆劃分為高高原機場。

en.title: COMAC High Altitude C919 Variant Completes First Test Flight in Shanghai
en.summary: The Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China completed the maiden test flight of its C919 high-altitude prototype in Shanghai on July 29, 2026. Taking off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG), the C919-600 aircraft, registered B-002U, flew for one hour and 59 minutes while completing all planned test flight maneuvers. Jointly developed with Tibet Airlines, the variant features a fuselage shortened by six frames and targeted system modifications to operate at high-altitude airports elevated at or above 2,438 meters. It is designed to seat between 140 and 160 passengers.
body: Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) completed the maiden test flight of its new C919 high-altitude prototype aircraft on July 29, 2026. Taking off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG), the C919-600 aircraft prototype, currently bearing registration B-002U, completed an inaugural test flight lasting one hour and 59 minutes before landing back at the airport.

According to an official press release issued by COMAC following the flight, the C919-600 high-altitude prototype aircraft successfully executed all scheduled test flight maneuvers and planned evaluation items. The commercial aircraft manufacturer stated that the successful flight marked a significant step forward in the overall serial development of the C919 aircraft family.

Prior to conducting its maiden flight in Shanghai, the B-002U prototype completed ground taxi trials at Shanghai Pudong International Airport in June 2026. Those ground trials enabled engineering teams to validate the aircraft's ground handling characteristics and assess system performance before advancing the aircraft into its flight testing phase.

Developed based on the baseline C919 platform, the C919-600 high-altitude variant incorporates specific targeted design modifications. The aircraft's fuselage is around six frames shorter than the standard baseline version, accompanied by structural weight reduction and targeted onboard system enhancements designed to fulfill operational requirements at high-altitude airports.

The specialized high-altitude variant is being jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines, featuring a planned passenger seating capacity ranging between 140 and 160 passengers. Under Chinese civil aviation regulatory standards, commercial airports situated at elevations of 2,438 meters (8,000 feet) or higher are classified as high-altitude airports.
